Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money.

In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Head of Environment and Employee Experience to shape how Notinos (our employees) connect with our mission, customers, and each other. Reporting to our Chief People Officer, you’ll lead the environment and employee experience team and drive the strategy for how we design, activate, and evolve our culture and our offices as places that foster creativity, collaboration, and community and enable our people to do the best work of their careers.

This is a highly strategic leadership role that has the ability to make an outsized impact on Notion’s next stage of growth, as we continue towards our goal of building a generational company. Our people are our most critical asset, and you will design the physical environments and experiences that enable them to ramp effectively when they join, level up their craft, foster a sense of belonging, and collaborate with each other in ways that drive real business outcomes for our customers and community.

This role is a core driver in shaping and building Notion’s culture. You’ll define the end‑to‑end employee experience strategy - from the first day they enter the office all the way to when they graduate to Alumni status. Your team will be the living embodiment of what Life @ Notion feels like on our best day and create the conditions that deepen affinity to Notion and inspires the willingness to go above and beyond.

This role combines workplace experience, real estate strategy, and cultural programming. You'll be responsible for everything from office design and space planning to creating the magical moments that matter to our people. From shaping cross-team rituals, to company-wide events, your work will directly influence how Notinos feel about coming into work, how they connect across teams and geographies, and how our physical and cultural environment reflects our values.

This role is based in San Francisco with an expectation of 4 days per week in-office.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the office experience strategy
   
   ◦ Define and evolve a clear vision for how our offices support collaboration, focus, and connection across hybrid and in-office teams.
   
   ◦ Design spaces and programs that reflect Notion's culture and make our offices destinations people want to be in, not obligations.

 - Lead real estate strategy and logistics
   
   ◦ Partner with leadership and Finance to develop and execute real estate expansion strategy as the company scales.
   
   ◦ Oversee lease negotiations, space planning, office operations, and logistics to ensure our physical environments are functional, inspiring, and aligned with how teams actually work.

 - Drive Notino engagement initiatives
   
   ◦ Design and run always on engagement initiatives. Synthesize insights and translate findings into actionable programs that strengthen connection and belonging.
   
   ◦ Build and scale cultural rituals, cross-team collaboration programs, and moments that matter, which bring people together around shared mission, values, and goals.

 - Lead company-level events and experiences
   
   ◦ Own the strategy and execution of company offsites, and other high-impact cultural moments that strengthen community and alignment.
   
   ◦ Create scalable event frameworks that work across a globally dispersed, hybrid organization.

 - Lead and develop the environment and engagement team
   
   ◦ Manage, mentor, and grow a team responsible for workplace experience, space design, engagement programming, and real estate operations.
   
   ◦ Set clear goals, provide regular feedback, and build a team culture that is creative, resourceful, and deeply attuned to employee needs.

 - Collaborate across People, Real Estate, and Operations
   
   ◦ Partner closely with the broader People team, Facilities, IT, Finance, and leadership to ensure our workplace strategy is integrated, sustainable, and supports business goals.
   
   ◦ Influence cross-functional stakeholders and build alignment on how we invest in and activate our physical and cultural environment.

 - Establish metrics and continuously improve
   
   ◦ Define success metrics for workplace experience, engagement, and space utilization, and use data to refine programs over time.
   
   ◦ Stay current on workplace trends, employee needs, and best practices from other high-growth companies.


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 12+ years of experience in workplace, environment, and/or employee experience roles, with a track record of building and scaling programs that make a measurable impact.

 - Experience leading globally dispersed teams, as well as designing always on engagement activities and owning strategy in a high-growth tech company environment.

 - Comfort navigating the complexities of in-office, hybrid employee experiences

 - Strong background in real estate portfolio management and expansion strategy, including space planning, lease negotiations, and scaling office footprints.

 - Proven ability to design and execute company-level events such as offsites and cultural moments, including management of Affinity Groups, that strengthen connection and alignment.

 - Ability to set clear vision, prioritize work, and develop talent in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

 - Comfortable setting long-term strategy while also rolling up your sleeves to solve immediate challenges - at Notion everyone has IC energy!

 - Experience designing and analyzing workplace data to inform decision-making that meaningfully shapes the employee experience

 - Comfort translating qualitative feedback and quantitative insights into clear action plans.


NICE-TO-HAVE SKILLS

 - Experience at a product-led or design-forward tech company.

 - Background in community building, hospitality, or experience design.

 - Familiarity with sustainability practices and inclusive design principles for workplace environments.

 - Experience managing vendor relationships and complex event logistics across multiple locations.

 - Genuine curiosity for how AI can be leveraged to scale thoughtful systems that remove the busywork and free up time to focus on your life’s work


WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE

 - Meaningful impact: You'll shape the environments and experiences that define what it means to work at Notion, influencing how hundreds of Notinos connect with our mission, customers, and each other.

 - High-visibility role: As Head of Environment and Employee Experience, your work will be felt across the company and have a direct line to leadership and culture.

 - Collaborative, thoughtful team: You'll work alongside a People team that cares deeply about craft, employee experience, and building a culture where everyone can do their best work.

 - Support for balance and wellbeing: Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits, including health coverage, flexible time off, and support for hybrid work.

 - Room to grow: You'll have the opportunity to build not just programs, but the systems, team, and long-term strategy that will scale with Notion.

We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. If you're excited about a role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every bullet point listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. If you're a builder at heart, share our company values, and enthusiastic about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you.

Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organisations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money.

In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays.


ABOUT THE ROLE:

In this position, you'll play a crucial role in shaping our go-to-market strategy and driving data-informed decision-making within the EMEA region. This position sits at the intersection of sales, strategy, and operations, offering the opportunity to significantly impact Notion's growth trajectory. You'll work closely with sales leadership and cross-functional teams to optimise processes, deliver actionable insights, and support key strategic initiatives. You will report directly to the Head of Regional Sales Strategy & Operations.


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Partner with EMEA leadership team to define and drive strategy (e.g. territory mapping, long-term account planning, geographic expansion) and results for the region by conducting insightful analysis on local EMEA markets and customers

 - Support the regional rhythm of the business, including business reviews, forecasting, and pipeline management cadences. Ensure that our global operating priorities are executed thoughtfully locally balancing regional nuance with

 - Support regional sales leaders and sales teams in achieving their goals by providing actionable insights and visibility to sales performance metrics

 - Build reporting and presentations for EMEA sales leadership to update on the state of the business, both up and across the organisation

 - Act as a partner to the EMEA sales team, providing hands-on operational support to drive deals forward and advising with decision-making

 - Partner with the GTM Systems team to continuously enhance our sales technology stack to provide both a best-in-class experience for our sellers and a robust sales data environment

 - Work with cross-functional teams including Legal, Finance, Product, Marketing, etc. as the primary operational counterpart on behalf of the EMEA sales org

 - Maintain and embed global sales policies, processes, and procedures, driving discipline with regards to strategy execution

 - Support global planning process locally, including target setting, capacity modelling, territory carving, etc.

 - Surface on-the-ground observations and insights to global sales and RevOps leadership


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - 5+ years of strategy, operations, and analytics experience with a track record of driving growth - working in sales operations, preferably in a high-growth SaaS environment

 - Expertise to quickly drill down into the business funnel for outbound and inbound sales motions, and how that connects to revenue

 - Excellent analytical and quantitative modelling skills; ability to analyse and interpret data, provide actionable insights, and deliver measurable results

 - Expert proficiency with core sales tools (e.g. Salesforce, Gong, Outreach, etc.) and best practices for sales data management

 - Expert level user of Gsheets / excel experience with BI and Data Analysis tools like Tableau or Hex in business user and/or analyst capacity. SQL proficiency is a plus

 - Strong collaborator, works well with stakeholders, gains trust, enjoys working with people

 - Demonstrates a senior presence and can convey complex information to executives clearly and concisely; can resolve tradeoffs. Effective communicator across levels and audiences

 - Hands on and proactive, with a builders mentality.

 - Maintaining high ownership mentality, demonstrated by developing projects of >6-12 months length

We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. We are seeking an experienced GTM Recruiting Leader to drive all sales recruiting efforts globally across the Americas (AMER), European (EMEA) and Asia Pacific (APAC) regions. This strategic leadership role will be responsible for building world-class sales teams across Solutions Engineering, Account Executives, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, and Professional Services. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in sales recruiting and a proven track record of scaling high-performing GTM organizations.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Lead end-to-end recruiting strategy: Develop and execute comprehensive recruiting strategies for all sales and GTM functions across the globe

 - Build high-performing teams: Partner with sales leadership to identify, attract, and hire top talent for Solutions Engineering, Account Executives, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, and Professional Services roles

 - Scale sales recruiting operations: Design and implement scalable recruiting processes, workflows, and systems to support rapid growth while maintaining quality of hire

 - Talent pipeline development: Build and maintain robust talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs across all sales disciplines

 - Team leadership: Manage and mentor a team of sales recruiters and global leaders, providing coaching, guidance, and professional development opportunities

 - Stakeholder partnership: Serve as a trusted advisor to our CRO and sales leadership, providing market insights, compensation guidance, and talent strategy recommendations

 - Metrics and reporting: Establish key recruiting metrics, track performance against goals, and continuously optimize recruiting effectiveness

 - Employer branding: Collaborate with marketing and talent brand teams to strengthen our employer value proposition in the sales community


REQUIREMENTS

 - 10+ years of recruiting leadership experience with a focus on sales and GTM roles

 - Proven track record of building and scaling sales organizations in high-growth environments

 - Deep expertise in recruiting across multiple sales functions including AEs, SEs, CS, RevOps, and Professional Services

 - Strong leadership skills with experience managing and developing recruiting teams

 - Strategic mindset with the ability to balance long-term planning with tactical execution

 - Data-driven approach to recruiting with strong analytical and reporting capabilities

 - Excellent stakeholder management and ability to influence senior sales leadership

 - Experience with modern recruiting tools and technologies (ATS, sourcing tools, candidate engagement platforms)

 - Knowledge of market dynamics and sales compensation trends


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience recruiting for SaaS or technology companies

 - Background in sales or revenue-generating roles

 - Experience with executive-level sales recruiting

 - Track record of implementing successful diversity recruiting programs

 - Strong network within the sales recruiting community

Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money.

In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays.


ABOUT THE ROLE:

This is an early-career role for builders who thrives in turning ambiguity into momentum. You'll wear many hats across the People team, but the core job is simple: jump in, chart the path, and drive projects based on business priority and impact. You'll make an outsized impact on Notion's People Experience by supporting the People Leadership team on high impact initiatives such as Employer Brand, Internal Mobility, and Global Onboarding.

This role is designed for a strong operator and communicator who brings cross-functional partners together thoughtfully, drives clarity, and executes at pace. Your steady hand and sharp execution will keep the People team running like a well-oiled machine—freeing the wider team to focus on enabling our employees to do their best work while creating magical moments that matter along the way.

Most importantly, we're looking for someone who is deeply curious, hungry to grow, and eager to hone their craft in People. You're someone who sees this role not as a stepping stone, but as a launchpad—an opportunity to learn from talented leaders, shape meaningful employee experiences, and develop expertise across the full spectrum of People work. You bring energy, optimism, and a genuine care for people. You're excited to be part of something bigger than yourself and to help build a workplace where everyone can do the best work of their careers.


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Strategize & Streamline: You'll focus on keeping the People team in aligned around our strategic objectives. You'll spot gaps before they become blockers, jump in where needed, put process in place where it makes sense, and unblock teams so they can ship.

 - Drive Business Impact: You drive projects from idea to execution, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities and measurable outcomes. You adapt quickly to feedback, embrace continuous improvement and keep initiatives on track, on time, and delivering real value.

 - Partner with Leadership: Support People leadership to navigate complex, sensitive matters with care and thought to ensure we always deliver an exceptional employee experience.

 - Collaborate with, well, almost everyone!: Whether it’s our People leadership team, project leaders, environment team, or new hires, you’ll partner with a wide range of Notinos and work across the organization as it scales globally.

 - Shape Culture: You build strong relationships across the organization, deeply understand what makes Notion special, and act as a culture carrier. As we scale, you’ll help preserve the values and moments that define us—ensuring our culture evolves thoughtfully without losing what makes it magical.


SKILLS YOU'LL BRING:

 - Builder’s Mindset: You're resourceful and willing to roll up your sleeves. You have strong organizational and project management skills, with experience managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. You anticipate change and see around corners. You take projects from start to finish with a bias toward action, turning ambiguity into clear next steps and shipping results.

 - AI Native: You're genuinely interested in AI technologies and eager to learn how to build with them. You see AI as a tool to automate workflows, reduce toil, and accelerate execution. Beyond personal use, you're excited to champion AI adoption across the People organization, helping teammates discover new ways to work smarter and more efficiently.

 - Proven track record of execution: You hold yourself to a high quality bar. Details matter. You test end-to-end. You use data and metrics to guide decisions. In whatever field or passion you've pursued, you've excelled—whether in academics, athletics, creative work, or professional projects. You're disciplined and focused, with a track record of moving fast without compromising on design and craft.

 - Thoughtful problem-solving: You approach problems holistically, starting with a clear and accurate understanding of the context. You can navigate ambiguity successfully, decompose complex problems into clean solutions, while also balancing the business impact of what you’re building.

 - Proactive communication and high agency: You own your work, communicating clearly about progress and blockers. You don't wait for instructions for every step but rather show initiative in identifying what needs to be done and driving projects forward. You ask questions when needed while independently finding solutions to problems.

We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. If you’re excited about a role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every bullet point listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. If you’re a builder at heart, share our company values, and enthusiastic about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you.

Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors, such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated hourly rate for this role is $40 - $57 per hour, annualized to a base salary range of $85,000 - $120,000 per year.

In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money.

In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays.


ABOUT THE ROLE:

 - Manage a large portfolio of customers in AMER.

 - Onboard and expand our customer base through tailored Notion consultations, trainings, and assistant programs.

 - Design and run at-scale outreach campaigns to key points of contact in order to assist with Notion adoption.

 - Work cross functionally with sales partners to ensure strong adoption of Notion.

 - Serve as our in-house product ambassador to up-level our customers’ workflows and help them get the most return of investment from Notion.

 - Identify and target strategic customers to engage with in order to drive up monthly active users and seat expansion.

 - Proactively identify customers who aren’t maximizing their opportunity with Notion and reach out to create an action plan to help them achieve success.

 - Inform and influence our overall growth strategy.


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 1. Drive adoption and expansion for a product people love that solves real problems: Some of the worlds largest companies use Notion to run huge teams — but your friends and family can also use it to take notes, display photos, and more. Some non-profits even use it to conserve wildlife https://twitter.com/DesertCrocs/status/1004845293018345472!

 2. Help build the foundations of Customer Success at Notion: As an early member of our sales/success team, you'll be instrumental in helping define our sales assisted motions.

 3. Serve as the customer's trusted advisor and product expert: You'll host training, onboarding, and working sessions to educate our customers and dig deep into new use cases of Notion.

 4. Meaningfully shape our future product: As you engage with customers, you'll gain insights to help us serve them better — and work with product to inform what we do next.

 5. Elevate your skills as we tackle our most impactful challenges: We've achieved more than teams 10x our size in less time — and there's so much more to do and learn.


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - 3+ years experience at a fast growing software company

 - You have a track record of success in your current Customer Success or Account Management role

 - Experience of managing a large volume of accounts

 - Strong intrinsic motivation to be a top performer and contribute to a team

 - You have a growth mindset and thrive in the building stage of a nascent team

Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money.

In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays.


ABOUT THE ROLE:

Millions of people use Notion — and this number is increasing every day. Our users depend on us to deliver a secure and trustworthy experience, and we value this more than anything. In this role, we are looking for a founding member of an elite security engineering team that is responsible for all aspects of ensuring the security of our platform and users. You will be one of Notion’s foremost security expert, understanding the full attack surface of our product and working with a broad range of teams to secure it.


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - You'll help scale the engineering organization and mentor engineers on best practices in secure software design and architecture.

 - You’ll enable the growth of Notion’s business by building a secure foundation that earns the trust of Notion’s users.

 - You’ll design, implement, and (where possible) automate a software development life cycle that balances good vulnerability and risk detection coverage with developer velocity.

 - You'll act as a liaison for multiple stakeholders across product, engineering, go to market, and security ops / compliance, to guide and prioritize the right security investments.

 - You'll participate in security assessments and advise on on both internal and customer security and privacy needs (e.g. SOC2, ISO 27001, GDPR, penetration testing, enterprise asks)


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Security architecture and expertise: You have experience building systems to secure and monitor cloud architectures. You can contribute directly to our main codebase to raise the bar on security systems design and address vulnerabilities. You bring experience in a number of following areas:
   
   - Threat modeling
   
   - Securing a cloud-based infrastructure (e.g. AWS)
   
   - Designing a secure development life cycle (design reviews, CI / CD integrations, bug bounty program)
   
   - Application security consulting
   
   - Secure library and framework development
   
   - Vulnerability discovery and response
   
   - Implement core security features like authentication to detecting and mitigating malicious activity
   
   - Offensive thinking (e.g. pentesting, red teaming)

 - Working in production: You have experience debugging systems in production. You appreciate the skill and challenge of continuously improving production components with minimal user disruption.

 - Pragmatic and business-oriented: You care about business impact and prioritize projects accordingly — you model threat risks and balance the right security investments with the right bottom line outcomes.

 - Not ideological about technology: To you, technologies and programming languages are about tradeoffs. You may be opinionated, but you're not ideological and can learn new technologies as you go.

 - Empathetic communication: You communicate nuanced ideas clearly, whether you're explaining technical decisions in writing or brainstorming in real time. In disagreements, you engage thoughtfully with other perspectives and compromise when needed.

 - Team player: For you, work isn't a solo endeavor. You enjoy collaborating cross-functionally to accomplish shared goals, and you care about learning, growing, and helping others to do the same.


NICE TO HAVES:

 - You've been responsible for maintaining continuous controls and participating in audits in relation to our customer facing certifications (like SOC2).

 - You have experience leading engineering teams with a security focus.

 - You've managed, maintained, and monitored systems using technologies like Amazon Web Services, Datadog, Postgres, Redis, Memcached, and Elasticsearch.

Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money.

In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays.


ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is transitioning from ‘start-up’ to ‘scale-up’. The AMER region currently accounts for a significant portion of our user base and global revenue. We are looking for an exceptional Sales leader to help scale us to the next level. Given the strong subscription and usage based revenue model, building out our sales program is a vital part of our long term growth strategy.

The AMER sales team drives both new customer acquisition and revenue expansion from existing customers. The team leverages inbound and greenfield lead generation channels while helping self-service customers upgrade to Enterprise products.


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - As the Manager, Mid-Market Sales, you will work directly with the Head of Mid-Market Sales, AMER to create and execute strategies for developing new revenue in this segment.

 - You will recruit, develop and lead a team of Account Executives, managing daily operations, setting clear performance expectations, and fostering a culture of high achievement and an environment where AE’s can do the best work of their career.

 - Partner with cross-functional leaders within Sales Strategy, Marketing and Sales Development teams to plan territory mapping and pipeline development programs.

 - Partner with the Customer Success and Solutions Engineering teams to onboard new customers and refine our customer journey to set new customers up for longer term success with Notion.

 - You understand the importance of communication and collaboration in defining a customer-first mentality, and you will work closely with our Product, Marketing and Commercial leadership teams to drive insight in to Ideal Customer Profile.

 - Help build the foundations of Sales at Notion: As an early member of our sales org, you'll be instrumental in helping define our sales assisted motions.

 - Join a fantastic team at a pivotal time: We've achieved profitability and grown to over 100 million users, creating vast opportunities ahead. This is the perfect moment to join and help shape our future expansion.

 - Meaningfully shape our future product: As you engage with customers, you'll gain insights to help us serve them better — and work with product to inform what we do next.

 - Elevate your skills as we tackle our most impactful challenges: We've achieved more than teams 10x our size in less time — and there's so much more to do and learn.


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - You are inspired by our mission: to help you build beautiful tools for your life’s work

 - You have 3+ years experience as a direct sales leader/manager

 - Strong track record of achieving sales targets across teams and individually

 - Skilled in managing and coaching through the full sales cycle from prospecting to closing

 - You have strong recognized leadership skills with a focus on empowerment, positive-mindsets, collaboration and ability to inspire a team of direct reports

 - You are comfortable with the ambiguity and pace of iteration of an early-stage startup

 - You have a growth mindset and thrive in the building stage of a nascent team

 - You view setbacks as learning opportunities, not failures

 - You have a high EQ and exceptional interpersonal skills, ability to manage influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus building

 - You have an analytical mindset and enjoy problem solving as part of a regional leadership team

 - You have strong empathy for customers and passion for revenue and growth

 - You have a good understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models


NICE TO HAVES:

 - You've built new business and expansion sales playbooks or processes

 - You've been a first or early hire at a fast growing start up before

 - Experience using Salesforce for accurate forecasting

 - Experienced in hiring and training talent at scale

 - Ability to function in a “Player/Coach” capacity as we scale AMER

 - Strong perspective and experience in building sales strategies for product-led growth (PLG) companies

We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email – with AI built in to find answers and automate work.

Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money.

Today, we're growing fast and excited for new teammates to join us who are the best at what they do. We're passionate about building a company as diverse and creative as the millions of people Notion reaches worldwide.

In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays. This internship will take place from May - September (based on your summer schedule) and you will need to be able to work out of our SF office during this time.


ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion has been transforming knowledge work, building a connected workspace and AI teammates that empower millions of professionals to spend less time on busywork and more on their life’s work. As a UX Research intern, you’ll work with the teams driving our product growth strategy, researching how users discover and adopt our expanding ecosystem of AI tools.


You'll independently run research projects from start to finish, translating stakeholder needs into concrete research plans and delivering insights that shape our product strategy. Working alongside passionate experts across Product, Design, Data, and Engineering, you'll help build the tools that millions of people rely on to get their work done.


This role is perfect for someone finishing their graduate studies, with plans to work in industry, and ready to take on impactful research projects at a company shaping the future of work.


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Design and conduct research studies to understand user behavior, needs, and how to improve their experience with Notion

 - Translate research findings into clear, actionable recommendations that inform product strategy and design decisions

 - Partner closely with cross-functional teams across Product, Design, Data Science, and Engineering to frame research questions and drive impact

 - Build relationships with stakeholders across the organization, learning to tailor your message for a variety of audiences – designers, engineers, executives – to ensure it lands

 - Contribute to how we understand and measure the value people get from Notion


QUALIFICATIONS

 - Currently pursuing a Master’s or PhD degree in a research-oriented field (e.g. HCI, Psychology, Cognitive Science, Sociology, Business, or related disciplines), with graduation in 2026 or 2027

 - At least one prior internship or substantial research experience that demonstrates your ability to work independently and deliver results

 - Available for a full-time internship from May–September 2026, with the ability to work onsite in our San Francisco office


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Strong research craft: You can independently design and execute studies from start to finish. You understand the strengths and limitations of various qualitative and quantitative methods (e.g. user interviews, usability testing, surveys) and know when to apply each to deliver the right insights.

 - Effective communication: You can distill complex data into clear, coherent narratives and explain your insights to cross-functional partners, both in writing and verbally.

 - Team player: You enjoy collaborating cross-functionally to accomplish shared goals, and you care about learning, growing, and helping others to do the same.

 - Product and business sense: You understand how research connects to business outcomes and can prioritize what matters most.

 - Adaptive problem-solving: You can navigate uncertainty, adapt to shifting priorities, and take initiative in a fast-paced environment.


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Familiarity with the software landscape that powers modern knowledge work and curiosity about how people adopt new technologies

 - Curiosity about AI and experience using AI tools to accelerate or improve your work

 - You use Notion to organize your life or work (and have opinions on how it could be better!)

We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. If you’re excited about a role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every bullet point listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. If you’re a builder at heart, share our company values, and enthusiastic about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you.

Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $57/hr for Bachelor’s, $61/hr for Master’s, and $65/hr for PhD.

Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money.

In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays.


ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're looking to hire our first Talent Sourcer to build top of funnel headcount growth and talent strategy across our Go-To-Market organization. In this role you will partner with GTM leadership to fill critical Sales, Customer Success and Marketing roles across APAC markets.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - You'll manage the sourcing process from inception through successful close, ensuring candidate and hiring manager experience are exceptional throughout every step of the way

 - You'll conduct initial qualification screenings and casual chats with candidates to assess fit and build relationships

 - You'll advance our Inclusion, Diversity, Equity, and Accessibility (I.D.E.A) strategy, working towards building more diverse and inclusive teams

 - You'll be a strategic advisor and talent sourcing expert leading successful searches across Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing

 - You'll collaborate with the broader team on process improvements, programs, and strategic initiatives

 - You'll make informed data-driven decisions that build efficiencies into the sourcing process

 - You'll find creative and unconventional ways to help us build a diverse top of funnel for GTM roles across all levels

 - You'll help build and manage partnerships to bring more underrepresented talent to Notion


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Manage sourcing for multiple complex and evergreen searches, creating innovative strategies and engagement to bring the best and most diverse talent to Notion

 - Help develop and execute comprehensive souring plans, analyzing requirements to determine target profile needs and matches

 - Partner closely with with other members of the Recruiting team to ensure we hit our hiring targets without sacrificing quality

 - Collaborate closely with Hiring Managers throughout the recruiting process to ensure we meet their hiring needs and goals

 - Establish and maintain meaningful relationships with management and key cross functional stakeholders


SKILLS AND TOOLSET YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - At least 2 years of experience in talent sourcing or recruitment, whether in-house or agency, or relevant transferable skills from related fields

 - Experience using LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing tools, with skills in Boolean and X-ray searches (or eagerness to learn these tools)

 - Persistence, consistency, and attention to detail- if we hire one person out of 200 candidates, you'd ensure the other 199 have a great experience. You care deeply about your craft

 - Strong time management, prioritization, and organizational skills- you are self-motivated and committed to excellence

 - You are kind, warm, and thoughtful- you'll represent the company when you interact with thousands of candidates each year

 - You're ready to contribute across the full scope of recruiting operations, whether it's maintaining our ATS databases, finding new ways to source candidates, organizing interviews, analyzing data to improve our recruitment efficiency, or managing sourcing channels

 - Fluent Japanese and business English skills

Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organisations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money.

In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays.


ABOUT THE ROLE:

 - Drive adoption, retention, and expansion for a product people love that solves real problems: You’ll work with a mix of customers who are deploying Notion across their company to solve for problems with collaboration and async work, using Notion as a knowledge base and a home for their project management

 - Serve as the customer's trusted advisor and product expert: You'll host training, onboarding, and working sessions to educate our customers and dig deep into new use cases of Notion.

 - Help build the foundations of Customer Success at Notion: As an early member of our team, you'll be instrumental in helping define our motion.

 - Meaningfully shape our future product: As you engage with customers, you'll gain insights to help us serve them better — and work with product to inform what we do next.

 - Elevate your skills as we tackle our most impactful challenges: We've achieved more than teams 10x our size in less time — and there's so much more to do and learn.


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Drive onboarding, adoption, utilisation, and growth in Notion’s existing customer base by owning specific customer accounts

 - Learn our product inside and out and help your customers drive business outcomes

 - Proactively identify customers who aren’t maximising their opportunity with our product/service and reach out to create an action plan to help them achieve success

 - Partner with the Sales team on accounts to expand use cases and create stickier customers

 - Collaborate with our Sales team to realise successful renewals and expansions

 - Innovate and iterate on Customer Success programs to retain and grow customers while mitigating churn or contraction

 - Surface opportunities to expand existing accounts when it’s right for the customer

 - Document and share key findings/learnings with broader Notion organisation


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - You have 5+ years experience of Customer Success at a fast growing software company with a track record of high achievement

 - You are a fluent German speaker

 - You’re highly adaptable, easily acclimating to a rapidly changing business and industry

 - You have a growth mindset and view setbacks as learning opportunities, not failures

 - Strong intrinsic motivation to be a top performer and contribute to a team

 - You can put yourself in others’ shoes and see situations from perspectives other than your own

 - You’re motivated by seeing others succeed and grow when you partner with them

 - You love getting to know new people and helping them solve their business problems


NICE TO HAVES:

 - You have experience training users of SaaS products

 - You have experience working with user communities

 - You've been an early customer success hire at a fast growing start up before

 - You've got strong technical chops

 - You have experience using Notion

 - You have experience using tools like Gainsight, Outreach, Salesforce

We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is hiring a GTM People Partner Lead to lead our global Go-To-Market (GTM) People Partner team. You will set the People Partnering strategy and operating model for GTM, grow and coach a distributed team, and partner closely with senior GTM leadership to drive strong org, talent, and performance outcomes.


WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Lead the global GTM People Partner team
   
   - Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing People Partner team across regions and time zones.
   
   - Establish a clear operating rhythm (prioritization, stakeholder routines, escalation paths).
   
   - Build shared standards, templates, and coaching approaches that improve quality and speed.

 - Partner with senior GTM leaders
   
   - Act as a trusted partner to Staff GTM leadership on org design, leadership effectiveness, and talent strategy.
   
   - Bring a clear point of view, with crisp recommendations and trade-offs.
   
   - Translate GTM strategy into People Partner priorities and team focus.

 - Drive talent, performance, and org health outcomes
   
   - Coach leaders through performance management (including sensitive and complex situations) with strong judgment and high care.
   
   - Lead talent planning and succession for critical GTM roles.
   
   - Identify risk areas early through strong signal gathering and trend analysis, then action improvements.

 - Balance global consistency with local requirements
   
   - Ensure core People Partnering principles are consistent globally, while honoring regional context and compliance needs.
   
   - Partner closely with Legal, Finance, Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, and People Operations to deliver cohesive outcomes.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

 - 10+ years of relevant experience in People Partnering, HRBP leadership, or closely related roles, including leading teams.

 - People leadership experience with a track record of developing People Partners.

 - Deep experience partnering with GTM orgs (Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, Marketing, Customer Experience, RevOps, or similar) in a fast-scaling environment.

 - Proven partnership with GTM leaders building their orgs for scale (team design, hiring plans, role clarity, leveling, leadership bench, and operating rhythms).

 - Strong craft in org design, performance management, and leadership coaching.

 - Comfort operating at the Staff/Executive level: influencing, challenging, and aligning senior leaders.

 - Systems mindset: you create lightweight, repeatable approaches that reduce rework and increase clarity.

 - Strong communication skills (clear writing, crisp synthesis, direct recommendations).


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience leading globally distributed People Partner teams.

 - Experience partnering across multiple geographies (e.g., US + EMEA + APAC).

 - Strong cross-functional fluency with Legal and Finance in high-stakes people decisions.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (FIRST 6–12 MONTHS):

 - GTM leaders describe People Partnering as clear, proactive, and high-trust across regions.

 - The global GTM People Partner team runs on a simple cadence with crisp ownership that aligns with the business, and fewer avoidable escalations.

 - Performance and talent actions are timely, consistent, and well-documented.

 - You’ve strengthened the bench and raised the bar on People Partner craft.

Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money.

In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Millions of people rely on Notion to do their most important work. Protecting that trust is foundational to everything we build.

Notion is looking for a Security Operations Engineer to join our Detection and Response team. In this role, you will help monitor, investigate, and respond to security events across Notion’s cloud-native and SaaS-focused environment, while contributing to the continuous improvement of our detection and response capabilities.

This role is well-suited for someone who enjoys hands-on security operations and wants to take on meaningful ownership over investigations, detections, and response workflows over time. You’ll work closely with experienced security engineers and analysts in a collaborative, high-trust environment that values learning, iteration, and operational excellence.



WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE

You will play a key role in protecting Notion’s systems, users, and employees by responding to security events and improving how we detect and respond to threats at scale.

 - Investigate and respond to security alerts end-to-end, including triage, scoping, containment, remediation, and documentation.

 - Participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation, responding to security alerts and incidents as part of a shared team responsibility.

 - Take ownership of specific detections, log sources, or investigation workflows, ensuring their quality, reliability, and ongoing improvement.

 - Contribute to detection development and tuning, identifying gaps, reducing false positives, and improving signal quality across telemetry sources.

 - Support incident response efforts, working with cross-functional partners to investigate and resolve security incidents.

 - Participate in proactive threat hunting, developing hypotheses based on threat intelligence, attacker behavior, and internal telemetry.

 - Analyze and correlate logs across cloud, identity, endpoint, and SaaS platforms to identify suspicious or anomalous behavior.

 - Improve operational processes and documentation, including runbooks, playbooks, and investigation procedures.
   


SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

5+ years of experience in security operations, incident response, detection engineering, or a related security role.


SECURITY MONITORING & DETECTION

 - Experience triaging and investigating alerts across SIEM, EDR, and cloud-native platforms.

 - Familiarity with detection development and tuning, including rule logic and false-positive reduction.

 - Working knowledge of attacker TTPs and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, and how to detect them using available telemetry.


INCIDENT RESPONSE

 - Understanding of the incident response lifecycle, including investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, and lessons learned.

 - Experience supporting real-world security investigations and documenting findings.

 - Ability to collaborate effectively with partners across Security, IT, and Engineering.


CLOUD & SAAS SECURITY

 - Familiarity with cloud environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) and common security risks.

 - Experience investigating identity and access activity in systems such as Okta, Google Workspace, or cloud IAM platforms.

 - Comfort working with logs from diverse sources, including authentication, endpoint, and infrastructure systems.


COLLABORATION & COMMUNICATION

 - Clear and thoughtful communicator who can explain technical issues to varied audiences.

 - Strong documentation skills to support consistent, repeatable incident handling.

 - Comfortable working across teams to solve complex security problems.


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience with scripting or automation (e.g., Python, Bash) to streamline investigations or improve analyst workflows.

 - Familiarity with detection logic or query languages such as Sigma, KQL, Splunk SPL, YAML, or YARA.

 - Security certifications such as Security+, GCIH, or equivalent.

 - Exposure to compliance or risk frameworks such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001.

 - Engagement with the security community through open source, blogs, talks, or research.


ON-CALL & OPERATIONS

 - This role participates in a 24/7 on-call rotation as part of the Detection and Response team.

 - On-call responsibilities include investigating alerts, responding to incidents, escalating when appropriate, and following established response procedures.

 - The team continuously works to improve detection quality and operational processes to maintain sustainable on-call practices.
   


INTERVIEW PROCESS

As part of the interview process, candidates will complete a short coding exercise designed to assess problem-solving, logic, and comfort working with data or automation commonly encountered in Detection & Response workflows. The exercise is intended to be practical and lightweight, not algorithm-focused.



NOT SURE IF YOU MEET EVERY REQUIREMENT?

We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every qualification. We’re looking for curious, security-minded individuals who are excited about Detection & Response and eager to grow their skills while protecting millions of Notion users.

Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Notion.

 - Help build playbooks and define our sales motion

 - Ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're looking for a Head of Internal Audit to establish and lead our Internal Audit function as we scale toward becoming a public company. This is a critical leadership role that will build the foundation for our audit program, implement SOX compliance, and ensure our internal controls are robust and effective. You'll work closely with our Finance, Legal, IT, Security, and Engineering teams to protect Notion's integrity and support our mission.


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Build and lead Internal Audit: Establish Notion's Internal Audit function from the ground up, including developing audit methodology, risk assessment frameworks, and reporting processes.

 - Build and manage the Internal Audit team: Hire, mentor, and lead the Internal Audit team, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and high ethical standards.

 - Implement SOX compliance: Design and execute our SOX 404 readiness program, including scoping, documentation, testing, and remediation of internal controls over financial reporting.

 - Drive risk-based auditing: Conduct comprehensive audits across finance, operations, security, and technology to identify risks and recommend improvements.

 - Partner with leadership: Work closely with senior management, including the CFO, CAO, General Counsel, and other executives (and the Audit Committee) to provide independent assurance and strategic guidance on risk management and internal controls.

 - Partner with Legal and Security teams to assess regulatory and policy compliance and provide independent assurance over the effectiveness of risk management, governance, and internal control processes.

 - Prepare for public company readiness: Build scalable processes and controls that will support Notion through IPO and beyond.

 - Foster a culture of compliance: Educate teams across Notion on internal controls, risk management, and audit best practices.


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - 15+ years of experience in internal audit, risk management, or a related field, with a strong mix of public accounting and industry experience.

 - Pre-IPO SOX implementation expertise: You've successfully built an Internal Audit function and led SOX 404 implementation at a high-growth, pre-IPO technology company.

 - Public company experience: You've managed Internal Audit operations at a public company and understand the ongoing compliance requirements.

 - Strong technical background: Deep understanding of COSO framework, PCAOB standards, and IT general controls (ITGCs).

 - CPA, CIA, or equivalent certification strongly preferred.

 - SaaS/technology expertise: Experience auditing technology companies with complex revenue models, subscription businesses, and cloud infrastructure.

 - Excellent communicator: You can translate complex audit findings into clear, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Builder mindset: You're energized by the opportunity to build something from scratch and create lasting impact.

 - Collaborative leader: You work effectively across functions and build strong relationships with stakeholders at all levels.


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with Big 4 public accounting firms

 - Knowledge of SOC 2, ISO 27001, or other security and compliance frameworks

 - Experience with audit management tools and data analytics platforms

 - International audit experience, particularly in EMEA or APAC regions

Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money.

In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays.


ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is a company of toolmakers. To build the best tools for our users, we need the best tools for ourselves.

You'll join a new team dedicated to building and improving Admin Mode—Notion's internal platform used by hundreds of employees across Customer Experience, Trust & Safety, Engineering, and other teams. Admin Mode is critical infrastructure and it's accessed daily by teams supporting millions of Notion users. You'll take ownership of a platform that directly impacts the productivity of every team at Notion.

You'll directly impact:

 - Notion's entire operational efficiency as the company scales

 - Customer Experience agents who rely on Admin Mode to support users

 - Trust & Safety teams protecting Notion users from abuse and security threats

 - Every engineering team that uses admin tools to debug and resolve issues


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Rebuild the foundation: Redesign Admin Mode's UI/UX to consolidate scattered workflows, reduce time-to-resolution for user issues, and make critical tools discoverable and fast.

 - Own reliability: When Admin Mode goes down, customer support grinds to a halt—you'll make sure it doesn't.

 - Enable extensibility: Build standardised APIs, permission testing utilities, and scaffolding that lets any team quickly add new admin tools.

 - Build tools: Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to transform ambiguous problem statements into tools that streamline their workflows.


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Tech stack: Node.js/TypeScript and React/TypeScript

 - 5+ years of experience leading and contributing to full stack applications working with cross-functional stakeholders.

 - You care about internal tools. You understand that developer experience and operational efficiency aren't nice-to-haves—they're force multipliers. You get excited about shaving 20 seconds off a workflow that runs 80 times per day.

 - You have deep empathy for users. You'll be building for Customer Experience agents resolving 50+ tickets daily, Trust & Safety investigators handling time-sensitive cases, and engineers debugging production issues at 2am. Understanding their workflows matters as much as the code.

 - You're a systems thinker. Admin Mode touches user accounts, workspace data, billing, security, and more. You need to think through permissions, audit trails, and edge cases—not just ship features fast.

 - You collaborate across teams. 90% of Admin Mode tools are owned by different engineering teams. You'll need to build consensus, establish standards, and communicate changes that affect deeply ingrained workflows.


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Having worked with LLMs and build real world applications.

 - Familiarity with TypeScript, Node.js, React

We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. If you’re excited about a role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every bullet point listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. If you’re a builder at heart, share our company values, and enthusiastic about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you.
